GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

3. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.

4. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   B. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.

5. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

7. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   B. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   D. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

11. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

13. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   B. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   D. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   D. Treat Rocks as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   B. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   D. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
